parsed.subject: URGENT: Your PayPal account has been suspended
parsed.body_text:
Dear Customer,

URGENT ACTION REQUIRED: Your PayPal account has been suspended due to unusual activity and unauthorized login attempts.

Your account will be permanently locked within 24 hours unless you verify your identity immediately.

Click here to verify your account now:
http://192.168.1.100/paypal-verify/login.php
http://bit.ly/paypal-urgent-verify
http://paypal.fake-secure-login.xyz/account/confirm

WARNING: Failure to act immediately will result in permanent account suspension and loss
